items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke announced a fresh protest in an X video message (Wednesday morning): a 'Lehra Do Tiranga' Tiranga march at Central Park, Connaught Place, Delhi, on October 16 at 5 PM, protesting the 5-day judicial custody of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Supporters were urged to bring the tricolour; those unable to reach Delhi were asked to organise Tiranga marches in their own cities. Dipke declared he is 'not afraid of jails' / 'ready to go to jail.'
items.title: Dipke calls fresh 'Lehra Do Tiranga' protest at Delhi's Connaught Place on Oct 16, 5 PM
